title: Training by law enforcement entities.
bodyText: Law enforcement entities shall include in their training programs for law enforcement officers and recruits information on the methods, technical aspects, and scientific findings regarding the basis of the eyewitness identification practices and procedures referenced in this chapter.
bodyHtml: [§801K-5]  Training by law enforcement entities.  Law enforcement entities shall include in their training programs for law enforcement officers and recruits information on the methods, technical aspects, and scientific findings regarding the basis of the eyewitness identification practices and procedures referenced in this chapter. [L 2019, c 281, pt of §2]
